summary.name: PocketBase
summary.one_liner: PocketBase is an open source Go backend packaged as a single executable, with an embedded SQLite database, realtime subscriptions, user and file management, and an admin dashboard.
use_cases: Backend for a SaaS product in a single file
Backend for a mobile or web app with realtime data
Self-hosting a small backend with a built-in admin UI
Building custom Go applications with added API routes
Extending a backend with JavaScript hooks
summary.what_it_does: PocketBase is an open source Go backend that bundles an embedded SQLite database with realtime subscriptions. It includes built-in user and file management and a Superuser dashboard UI for administration. It exposes a simple REST-style API, and official JavaScript and Dart SDK clients are provided. It can be used as a standalone prebuilt executable (run with ./pocketbase serve) or as a Go library to add custom routes and business logic. Prebuilt executables include a JS VM plugin for extending it with JavaScript.
notable: Single portable executable with embedded SQLite database
Realtime subscriptions and built-in users and files management
Usable as a standalone app or as a Go framework/toolkit
Official JavaScript and Dart SDK clients
caveats: Still under active development; full backward compatibility is not guaranteed before v1.0.0
Recent releases note breaking-style changes, such as the Go encoding/json v2 migration, so testing before upgrading is advised
Pure Go SQLite driver supports only a listed set of GOOS/GOARCH targets
